description: EasyLab Agent — chat with the easy-rpc agent backend
head_top:
<!-- Flutter replaces $FLUTTER_BASE_HREF with the build base (default /). -->
  <base href="$FLUTTER_BASE_HREF">
  <meta content="IE=Edge" http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible">
body:
<!--
    Point the engine's runtime fallback-font downloads (missing-glyph Noto
    fonts and the default Roboto) at a LOCAL base. The engine default is
    fonts.gstatic.com, which is unreachable on many mobile networks: the
    resulting font-fetch retry storm left the app blank/never-rendered on
    phones. Set BEFORE the bootstrap so the engine reads it during init.
    Unknown local paths 404 (harmless: the fallback service degrades
    gracefully), and NO request ever leaves for gstatic.
  -->
  <script>
    window.flutterConfiguration = Object.assign(
      window.flutterConfiguration || {},
      { fontFallbackBaseUrl: "fallback-fonts/s/" },
    );
  </script>
  <script src="flutter_bootstrap.js" async></script>
